content.title: 23. Appendix
content.summary: Appendix listing the ESC Scientific Document Group, document reviewers, and ESC National Cardiac Societies involved in the review of the 2023 ESC Guidelines for management of acute coronary syndromes.

sections.ESC Scientific Document Group: Includes Document Reviewers and ESC National Cardiac Societies.
sections.Document Reviewers: Multiple individual reviewers from a wide range of countries are listed in full on the page. Personal names have been omitted here.
sections.ESC National Cardiac Societies: States that national cardiac societies were actively involved in the review process and begins a country-by-country listing (examples shown include Algeria, Armenia, Austria, Belgium, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Czechia, Denmark, Egypt, Estonia, Finland, France, Georgia, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Ireland). The listing continues beyond the visible excerpt.

content.notes: The page is an administrative appendix; no clinical recommendations or gene mentions are present in the visible excerpt.
